title: The fast path: "fix this" by voice is live in 10–30 s

message.text: The plan (/framework/ai/2026-10-01/quick-fix-path/plan.md): you say "make this bold" → the smart assistant calls one Servex tool, quick_fix, with the page and the selected element → Servex hands it to a standing warm fixer that already holds a ready qf worktree (no spawn, no new worktree) → it edits a few lines, commits, and runs merge.mjs --quick: smoke test, ONE screenshot at the width that matters, merge, no reviewer when the change is ≤20 lines in one module → your page reloads and one chat line shows the seconds and the shot. Node stamps asked_at and landed_at and writes the seconds to /framework/ai/quick-fix/ so the time to first fix is measured, never guessed. Bigger than that → the fixer says so and hands it to a task mastermind. Two Sonnet minions: fixer (the standing agent, the tool, the timing) and quick-merge (--quick, and the one rule for which widths a change needs — also used by every normal review). Target 10–30 s; budget $22.

The 21:42 Servex restart emptied the spawn queue, so the fixer and quick-merge minions never started. Both are re-queued now (positions 2–3 behind a 5/5 working cap); the queue bug itself is added to the never-lose-a-wake minion's brief.

Fixer is in michael/dev as fa00e7d4: the standing quick-fix agent fixer-1, the quick_fix tools, and the live page at /framework/ai/quick-fix/. Both proofs pass here (fixer.test.mjs 6/6, pool-hold.test.mjs 5/5). It goes live on the next Servex restart, which I batch with the never-lose-a-wake landing. Quick-merge (the --quick merge and the four widths) is still being built.

quick-merge (minion-quick-merge-2): widthsFor() is in review.mjs (picks 1200 alone, all four, 400 alone, or 400+1920 by what changed — owner's own words quoted in the code) and merge.mjs --quick reuses it for a one-shot, no-reviewer-agent fast merge. Proofs pass (unit test, scratch-repo gate+JSON, two real screenshots). Fresh-eyes review is running now; will report landed or blocked next.

For mastermind-servex: the `review` skill (.claude/skills/review/SKILL.md) now needs an update — I can't edit skills myself. Its "What you are given" tree (lines ~24-31) still shows all four pngs always existing, and its "Pick the widths by what changed" section (lines 33-38) tells the REVIEWER to shoot extra widths itself. Both are stale: Server/review.mjs now picks the widths itself (widthsFor, before the reviewer ever starts), so shots/<page>/ can hold just one png. Suggested replacement for lines 24-38 — "`shots/<page>/` holds one png per width `review.mjs`'s own `widthsFor` picked for this change (never all four by default — see Server/doc/review.md's 'Which widths' table for the exact rule), plus `sheet.png` and `layout.json`. You don't shoot anything yourself and don't need to second-guess the pick; just say in one line of the review which widths you were given." Full detail of the new rule: Server/doc/review.md#which-widths.

quick-merge (minion-quick-merge-2): landed. widthsFor() (review.mjs) and merge.mjs --quick are applied to michael/dev's working tree — "applied", not "merged" (git log michael/dev..HEAD is empty, the owner commits). A fresh-eyes review passed with 5 notes (2 fixed, 2 noted, 1 declined-and-accepted). All proofs pass: review.test.mjs (13 checks), a scratch-repo proof of --quick's gate + JSON line, and two real screenshots proving widthsFor's pick becomes one png, not four. Returning the worktree now; it has pre-existing live-site census churn (files.jsonl) so worktree-down.mjs left the dir on disk after stopping its server — nothing of mine to clean up there.

For mastermind-servex, re skills: minion/improvements.md now has TWO independent reports (jsonl-writers, and mine) of the same real bug: node Server/review.mjs <taskdir> <worktree> run from inside a worktree resolves <taskdir> against cwd, so review.md/the task.jsonl review line land in the worktree's own copy — invisible to merge.mjs's reviewGate, which only ever reads MAIN. That's "a recurring line is a rule waiting to be written" per the skill's own header — worth promoting into the minion skill directly rather than a third minion hitting it.

Quick-merge is in michael/dev as cb164b1a: merge.mjs --quick and review.mjs widthsFor (one screenshot at the width that matters; 13 checks pass here). Both halves of the fast path are now committed; the fixer side went live with the 18:55 restart, and --quick is a script so it is live already. The review skill now says the widths are pre-picked, and the minion skill carries the "run review.mjs against MAIN" rule two minions tripped over. Still to measure: the time to first fix on a real voice "fix this".
